title: Narrow a long without wrapping

blocks.text: A narrowing cast such as `(int) someLong` keeps only the low 32 bits: `(int) 2147483648L` is `-2147483648`. The page's advice is to **check the range before casting**.

Write `Narrowing.clampToInt(long value)`. A value that fits in an `int` is returned unchanged. A value above `Integer.MAX_VALUE` returns `Integer.MAX_VALUE`, and a value below `Integer.MIN_VALUE` returns `Integer.MIN_VALUE`.

cases.says: A value that fits in an int is returned unchanged.
A value above the int range gives Integer.MAX_VALUE, not a wrapped number.
A value below the int range gives Integer.MIN_VALUE.
